name: 水滴蛇
evolution: 水滴蛇 → 水蛇锁 Lv.16 → 游蛇魔使 Lv.36
description: 和水滴蛇对上眼神的时候，最好保持礼貌并尝试解答它们留下的难题，如果拒绝回答或敷衍，往往会招来恶作剧，让你在不知不觉中迷路或错过冒险的宝藏。
descriptionEn: When you lock eyes with a Water-drop Snake, best keep polite and try to solve the riddles they leave. Refusing or half-answering often brings pranks, making you lose your way or miss adventure treasure without realizing it.

skills.name: 潮涌
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 影袭
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 水幕冲击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 破防
skills.description: 敌方获得双防-70%，应对防御：额外使被应对技能冷却2回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Enemy gains both defenses -70%; respond to defense: additionally puts the responded skill on 2-turn cooldown.

skills.name: 叠势
skills.description: 造成魔伤，2连击，每成功应对1次，本技能连击数永久+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; 2 hits; each successful response permanently adds +2 hits to this skill.

skills.name: 提气
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+40，若敌方本回合更换精灵，额外获得威力+50。
skills.descriptionEn: Gain all skills power +40; if enemy switches this turn, additionally gain power +50.

skills.name: 打鼾
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 预备势
skills.description: 自己获得物攻+80%，应对防御：额外使敌方获得物防-80%。
skills.descriptionEn: Gain attack +80%; respond to defense: additionally enemy gains defense -80%.

skills.name: 涌泉
skills.description: 造成魔伤，本技能能耗每-1，威力+10。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each -1 energy cost of this skill, power +10.

skills.name: 落雨
skills.description: 将天气改为雨天，持续8回合。
skills.descriptionEn: Change weather to Rain for 8 turns.

skills.name: 听桥
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：对敌方造成武系物理伤害，威力与被应对技能相等。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduce damage 60%; respond to attacks: deal Fighting physical damage to enemy equal to the responded skill's power.
